snippets.snippet_text: "Video content is the most popular genre, constituting 25.88% of all profiles on the platform (54,582 creators) as of January 2025."

"Some of the other popular categories of content on the platform include music (with 15,530 profiles), Gaming (13,688 profiles), Writing (10,997), Adult Video(8,803), Comics (6,812), Adult Games (4,642), Adult Photography (2,375), Adult Cosplay (1,378), and Cosplay (1,044 profiles)."
